title: Evaluate Boolean Expression
summary: Each expression compares two named variables with one operator. Look up each operand's value and return the expression with its boolean result.
inputFormat: SQL. Variables(name, value) with name primary key and value int. Expressions(left_operand, operator, right_operand); operands name variables.
outputFormat: SQL result: left_operand, operator, right_operand and value, where value is the string 'true' or 'false'.
tieRules: No ties; one output row per expression.
edgeRules: Operators are <, > and =. Operand names are assumed to exist in Variables.
